payload.summary: Package 15's CSRF Origin check has unit coverage only and its browser suite is red
payload.detail: PR #2627 adds src/lib/api-csrf.ts, which rejects a state-changing API request whose Origin does not match the addressed host. No browser or Playwright journey exercised it; Production UI (3) is red on that PR and CI triage classifies it not baselined, so the main comparison says nothing either way. A same-origin flow arriving with an Origin that neither Host nor X-Forwarded-Host reflects - a rewriting proxy in front of Railway - would now be refused where it previously passed. Must not merge until that browser suite is green or the failure is shown not to belong to the change. Recorded 2026-09-04.
